name: slack
description: Slack AI tools for users and developers: interact with your workspace via the Slack MCP server and use skills to develop Slack apps.

CLIENT_ID.title: Client ID
CLIENT_ID.description: The client ID of a Slack app your team created. The app must be internal or published in the Slack Marketplace. Every team member signs in under it.

CLIENT_SECRET.title: Client secret
CLIENT_SECRET.description: The client secret of that Slack app. Stored encrypted.
